bundle.shortDescription: A Bible study library: translations, commentaries, and the Hebrew and Greek
bundle.longDescription: A Bible study library on your device: 44 English translations, commentaries from the Church Fathers to the Reformation and after, cross-references, and the Hebrew and Greek behind the King James Version, all offline and searchable, with an optional study assistant that uses the AI service you choose.
